subject: New seller onboarding: information to complete vendor setup
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karen Alvarez <karen@luminalabs.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: New seller onboarding: information needed to set up vendor profile

Hi Karen,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for the integration pilot — excited to get Lumina Labs onboarded so we can start routing POs and invoices. To avoid delays on payments and PO creation, could you send the items below by end of week? We can keep initial terms Net30 unless you request otherwise.

Checklist (what we need to create a vendor profile and accept POs/payments):
1) Legal entity name and any DBA (exact wording for invoices)
2) Tax ID / EIN (and country) — W-9 or equivalent
3) Remit-to address (street, city, state, ZIP, country)
4) Invoice email and PO contact name/phone
5) Preferred payment method (ACH or wire) and payment terms (NetX)
6) If ACH: bank name, routing number, account number, account holder name, account type
7) If wire: bank SWIFT/BIC and beneficiary details
8) Voided check or bank letter for ACH verification
9) W-9 or tax certificate (attachment ok)

I attached a short PO template for reference — it shows the fields our finance team needs on submitted invoices. If any of this data is sensitive, feel free to upload via the secure link below (expires in 48h):
https://uploads.redwoodinference.com/secure/abc123

Cc'ing Grace from Finance who'll do the vendor record and Sean from Sales if any commercial questions about PO handling come up.

Appreciate a quick note with ETA. If it's easier, we can do a 15-minute call to go through items.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment: PO-template.pdf (stub)

Date: 2027-04-22T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New seller onboarding: information needed to set up vendor profile

Thanks for the clear list. Attached is our completed W-9 and the company details below. We can do ACH and prefer Net30. I included the person who handles billing on our side.

Lumina Labs, Inc.

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-22T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: New seller onboarding: information needed to set up vendor profile

Markus / Sean —

Thanks — W-9 looks good at first pass. Two quick follow-ups before I create the vendor record (several items must match exactly to the W-9 to pass our bank/finance checks):

- Confirm the exact legal entity string you want on the vendor master (Lumina Labs, Inc. vs. Lumina Labs) — we use the legal name for 1099/1098 reporting.
- Ask the vendor to provide one of: voided check, bank letter on bank letterhead, or ACH authorization form. The secure upload link is fine; please remind them it expires in 48h.
- Confirm if Lumina accepts PO-numbered invoices only, or if they can also invoice pre-PO for one-off charges. If PO-only, we will need to ensure Sales issues a PO number every time.

Sean — can you confirm whether Sales will insist on PO numbers for pilot spend or if we allow a one-time invoice without PO? I can proceed to create the vendor record with temporary payment hold if we need PO enforcement.

Grace
Sr. Manager, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karen Alvarez <karen@luminalabs.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-23T08:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New seller onboarding: information needed to set up vendor profile — checklist/next steps

Hi Karen —

Appreciate the quick response and the W-9. Grace flagged a few items we still need to finalize to set up the vendor record and enable ACH:

Required to create vendor and enable ACH payments (please return these items):
A) Confirm legal entity (exact string for vendor master): Lumina Labs, Inc. (confirm)
B) Remit-to address (we have Palo Alto address above; confirm mailing address for checks if different)
C) ACH details (preferred):
   - Bank name
   - Routing number
   - Account number
   - Account holder name (must match legal entity)
   - Account type (Checking/Savings)
D) Voided check or bank letter on bank letterhead (attachment)
E) Invoice requirements: please confirm whether invoices must include a PO number and if there is a billing contact email for invoice exception handling (we have billing@luminalabs.com and Maya Patel)
F) For compliance: indicate if any payments will be routed to a non-US entity or require VAT/international tax handling

If you prefer, we can collect ACH details securely via DocuSign or our secure upload; pick whichever you prefer and reply with the ETA. Once Grace confirms the matching details, Finance will create the vendor record and issue a vendor code — we will then share the vendor number and confirm PO workflow.

Attachment: PO-template.pdf (stub)

Thanks,
Markus
From: Karen Alvarez <karen@luminalabs.com>

Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Maya Patel <maya.patel@luminalabs.com>

Markus / Grace —

Thanks — confirming legal name is Lumina Labs, Inc. Remit-to address is correct for checks. We prefer ACH; banking details are below and I also uploaded a bank letter and a voided check to your secure link.

Routing: 111000025
Account: 987654321
Account holder: Lumina Labs, Inc.
Account type: Checking

Please let us know the vendor code once the record is created and any next steps on issuing a PO for the pilot.

Best,
Karen
